Select distinct molecule ChEMBL identifiers and canonical SMILES for compounds tested in human assays against human Beta-secretase 1 (CHEMBL4822). Join molecule_dictionary to activities, assays, and target_dictionary, filtering by target ChEMBL ID CHEMBL4822 and assay organism Homo sapiens. Join compound_structures to retrieve canonical SMILES. Return columns compound_chembl_id and canonical_smiles. Sort by compound_chembl_id.
